title: Tagged line ranges versus exact text replacement on existing code
hypothesis: Tagged range edits will preserve correctness while requiring fewer model turns and failed mutations than unique oldText/newText replacement on focused multi-file changes.
falsified_if: Exact replacement has equal deterministic pass rate and no material regression in failed mutations, model calls, response size, or latency; or tagged edits introduce a failure category absent from exact replacement.
decision_rule: Reject either format on a repeatable deterministic correctness or scope failure. If both pass, prefer the format with fewer failed mutations and existing-file overwrites; use model calls, response size, changed lines, and latency as secondary evidence. Do not change production from five runs per cell alone: confirm the winner on at least two additional edit scenarios covering ambiguous repeated text and stale-file recovery.
